documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Board Meeting Intimation for Consideration And Approval Of The Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone And Consolidated) Of The Company For The Quarter And Half Year Ended September 30, 2026.
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Man Industries reported its Q1 FY27 earnings with a consolidated revenue of INR1,065 crores and record consolidated EBITDA of INR155 crores. Management highlighted a strong consolidated order book of approximately INR3,600 crores and a combined bid pipeline of INR24,000 crores, backed by multiyear structural demand shifts in energy and water infrastructure. The company is expanding through the integration of National Pipe Company in Saudi Arabia, an upcoming coating and double jointing facility in Dammam, and a greenfield stainless steel project in Jammu. Management guided for an annual top-line growth of 25% to 30% for FY28. Man Industries reported a consolidated revenue of ₹35,925 million for FY26, supported by its manufacturing operations in India and the recent acquisition of National Pipe Company (NPC) in Saudi Arabia.

guidance.claim: Management expects NPC quarterly run rate from Q2 to be between INR300 crores and INR500 crores.
guidance.quote: And NPC quarterly run rate from Q2, we are assuming between -- any time between INR300 crores to INR500 crores.

guidance.claim: Management estimates a minimum growth of 25% to 30% for FY28.
guidance.quote: So we would be doing approximately 25% to 30% growth.

guidance.claim: Management projects a top line between INR2,400 crores and INR3,000 crores from Saudi Arabia for FY28 onwards.
guidance.quote: So FY28 onwards, we are looking at between -- anything between INR2,400 crores to INR3,000 crores top line from Saudi.

guidance.claim: The full financial impact and earnings contribution from NPC are expected from Q2 FY27 onwards.
guidance.quote: The full financial impact and earnings contribution from NPC are expected to be reflected from Q2 FY27 onwards.

demand_outlook.claim: Management notes that industry demand represents a structural multiyear shift driven by government and national oil company investments.
demand_outlook.quote: What we are seeing across our markets isn't a one-off up cycle. It's a structural multiyear shift.

demand_outlook.claim: Management indicates that supply is lower than demand and expects this shortfall to continue for the next 3 to 4 years.
demand_outlook.quote: Currently, there is a shortfall of between demand and supply. So supply is lower and demand is higher. And we expect this to continue for the next 3 to 4 years, looking at the current -- with the war scenario and everything, a lot of new projects, the East-West line, the Master Gas expansion.

demand_outlook.claim: Management states that Asian countries are urgently diversifying supply chains and expanding LNG import and distribution infrastructure.
demand_outlook.quote: Countries from Japan, Korea, Vietnam, Bangladesh and Philippines are now urgently diversifying their supply chain, locking in long-term contracts with non-Gulf producers and expanding LNG import and distribution infrastructure to reduce the concentration risk.

demand_outlook.claim: Structural investment across energy, water, and industrial infrastructure is driving large-diameter pipe demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Structural investment across energy, water, and industrial infrastructure is driving large-diameter pipe demand well beyond any single market or project cycle.

capex_expansion.claim: Operations at the Dammam coating and double jointing facility are targeted to commence by March 2027.
capex_expansion.quote: On our upcoming Dammam coating and double jointing facility, this further strengthens our integrated manufacturing, value-added processing capabilities in Kingdom with operations targeted to commence by March '27.

capex_expansion.claim: Construction of the Jammu greenfield stainless project remains on track with production expected by March 2027.
capex_expansion.quote: On our Jammu greenfield stainless project, construction remains on track with production expected by March '27.

capex_expansion.claim: The Dammam coating plant involves an investment of USD50 million, funded partly by a USD25 million loan and USD25 million internally.
capex_expansion.quote: Then we are putting up a coating plant in Saudi that is going on, which is around USD50 million investment, which will be funded partly by loan, USD25 million, USD25 million, we will do from our own.

capex_expansion.claim: The Jammu project requires INR600 crores, with a loan component of INR389 crores and the balance funded internally.
capex_expansion.quote: And Jammu project, which is going on for INR600 crores, the loan component will be INR389 crores and balance our component, we have already invested in the project so far.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is setting up a stainless steel seamless pipe facility in Jammu with a production target of March 2027.
capex_expansion.quote: Jammu Stainless Steel Plant- Production Targeted: Mar’2027

capex_expansion.claim: The company is developing a coating plant in Dammam, Saudi Arabia, with production targeted for March 2027.
capex_expansion.quote: Dammam Coating Plant (KSA)- Production Targeted: Mar’2027

capex_expansion.claim: The Dammam Coating Plant in Saudi Arabia has production targeted for March 2027.
The Jammu Stainless Steel Plant has production targeted for March 2027 with a capacity of 22,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: Jammu Stainless Steel Plant-Production Targeted for Mar’2027

capex_expansion.claim: The capital outlay for acquiring NPC was approximately Rs. 960 crore (US$102 million) funded via US$70 million debt and US$32 million equity.
capex_expansion.quote: ~₹960 Cr (US$102 Mn) —US$70 Mn debt + US$32 Mn equity

margins_costs.claim: On a stand-alone basis, Q1 FY27 revenue grew 37.5% year-on-year to INR1,028 crores and EBITDA grew 95.1% year-on-year to INR157 crores.
margins_costs.quote: On a stand-alone basis, revenue grew 37.5% year-on-year to INR1,028 crores. EBITDA grew 95.1% year-on-year to INR157 crores, with EBITDA margin expanding 450 basis points to 15.3%.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA reached INR155 crores, up 92.6% year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: On the consolidated basis, we delivered our highest ever consolidated quarterly EBITDA of INR155 crores, which is up 92.6% year-on-year and 5% quarter-on-quarter, driven by the strategic optimized product and geographic mix and continued deepening of our global order pipeline.

margins_costs.claim: NPC is operating at an EBITDA margin of almost 21%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin for NPC is still higher, almost 21%, of which NPC is operating.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects full-year finance costs to be around INR190 crores.
margins_costs.quote: So at the year-end, I expect my finance cost full year will be around INR190 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Management anticipates that the coating facility will push the NPC margin profile up by at least 3% to 4%.
margins_costs.quote: This is with the coating facility would be probably a few more percentage up once NPC coating starts. So the margin profile will definitely kick up at least 3% to 4%.

margins_costs.claim: NPC is earnings accretive with a 15-18% EBITDA margin and 11-14% PAT margin.

orders_capacity.claim: The consolidated order book stands at approximately INR3,600 crores across India and Saudi Arabia.
orders_capacity.quote: Our consolidated order book stands at approximately INR3,600 crores across India and Saudi Arabia, with the majority executable order over the next 6 to 12 months, giving us a strong revenue visibility into the rest of FY27.

orders_capacity.claim: The combined bid pipeline stands at approximately INR24,000 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Beyond that, our combined bid pipeline stands at approximately INR24,000 crores, giving us a substantial base for future order inflows.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization in India is approximately 50% to 60%.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity utilization is approximately when you talk about India, is around 50% to 60%.

orders_capacity.claim: The total capacity of the LPE coating coming up in Saudi Arabia is 4 lakh square meters per annum.
The company has a combined manufacturing capacity exceeding 1.2 million tonnes per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: With a combined manufacturing capacity exceeding 1.2 million tonnes per annum (TPA), the plants produce LSAW, HSAW, and ERW pipes, maintaining stringent quality control at every stage.

orders_capacity.claim: NPC's order book on day one was US$120 million with L1 status on further orders.
orders_capacity.quote: US$120 Mn, with L1 status on further orders

orders_capacity.claim: NPC holds Aramco approved-vendor status continuously since 2005.

capital_allocation.claim: Merino Shelters project cash inflows are anticipated to be between INR35 crores and INR50 crores in the current financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: Merino Shelters also, as Mr. Nikhil ji just mentioned, has got the RERA certification received and project is getting launched next month, we are anticipating INR50 crores -- INR35 crores to INR50 crores cash inflows in this current financial year.

capital_allocation.claim: Total debt is projected to reach a maximum of INR1,600 crores if all project drawdowns are completed by March 2027.
capital_allocation.quote: Total debt will be around INR1,600 crores after all the projects get completed and all drawdown happens.

capital_allocation.claim: Merino Shelters expects Rs. 35-50 crore cash flow in FY27.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management notes that new players coming to Saudi Arabia might create some pressure on prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: Yes, there might be some pressure on the price. That's always the case, but it is not like a price war like you're saying.

risks_headwinds.claim: Contribution from NPC in Q1 was lower given the limited 40-day period.
risks_headwinds.quote: Contribution from NPC in Q1 was lower given the limited 40-day period, during which takeover and integration progressed well.

management_commitments.claim: Operations for the Dammam coating and double jointing facility are targeted to commence by March 2027.
management_commitments.quote: On our upcoming Dammam coating and double jointing facility, this further strengthens our integrated manufacturing, value-added processing capabilities in Kingdom with operations targeted to commence by March '27.

management_commitments.claim: Production for the Jammu greenfield stainless project is expected by March 2027.
management_commitments.quote: On our Jammu greenfield stainless project, construction remains on track with production expected by March '27.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects the full financial impact of the NPC acquisition to be reflected from Q2 FY27 onwards.
management_commitments.quote: The full financial impact and earnings contribution from NPC are expected to be reflected from Q2 FY27 onwards.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets production from the Jammu stainless steel plant by March 2027.
management_commitments.quote: Jammu Stainless Steel Plant- Production Targeted: Mar’2027

management_commitments.claim: The company targets production from the Dammam coating plant by March 2027.
management_commitments.quote: Dammam Coating Plant (KSA)- Production Targeted: Mar’2027

management_commitments.claim: Production at the Dammam Coating Plant in KSA is targeted to start by March 2027.
Production at the Jammu Stainless Steel Plant is targeted for March 2027.
management_commitments.quote: Jammu Stainless Steel Plant-Production Targeted for Mar’2027

management_commitments.claim: Merino Shelters expects Rs. 35-50 crore cash flow in FY27.
Merino Shelters expects Rs. 700-800 crore revenue in the next 5-6 years.
management_commitments.quote: Rs. 700-800 Cr Revenue in next 5-6 Years

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
